title: Pantry Equipment, Fit-Out and Deposit Schedule (Office Pantry & Beverage Program)
content:
Equipment supplied with an Office Pantry & Beverage Program pantry, the fitting work that precedes the first delivery, and the sums held and charged against that equipment are printed tier by tier.

## Equipment carried in the tier

| Tier | Bean-to-cup espresso machine part of the tier | Plumbed filtered water part of the tier | Planned service visits to pantry equipment each year |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Coffee & Tea Service | no | no | 2 |
| Standard Snack Pantry | no | yes | 2 |
| Fresh Pantry Program | yes | yes | 4 |
| Barista Bar Program | yes | yes | 6 |
| Full Hospitality Pantry Program | yes | yes | 8 |
| Campus Pantry Network Program | yes | yes | 12 |

## Fitting, deposit and collection

| Tier | One-off charge for fitting shelving, dispensers and machines (USD) | Fitting lead time before the first delivery (calendar days) | Refundable deposit held for pantry equipment (USD) | Charge for collecting equipment at closure (USD) |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Coffee & Tea Service | 220.00 | 7 | 150.00 | 120.00 |
| Standard Snack Pantry | 580.00 | 10 | 350.00 | 240.00 |
| Fresh Pantry Program | 1650.00 | 18 | 950.00 | 520.00 |
| Barista Bar Program | 4200.00 | 28 | 2200.00 | 880.00 |
| Full Hospitality Pantry Program | 7600.00 | 40 | 3800.00 | 1450.00 |
| Campus Pantry Network Program | 15800.00 | 60 | 6500.00 | 2900.00 |

## Notes to the schedule

- The espresso and water lines record whether a bean-to-cup espresso machine and plumbed filtered water are part of the tier. The service figure is the number of planned service visits to pantry equipment each year.
- The fitting charge is a one-off charge for fitting shelving, dispensers and machines. The fitting lead time is stated in calendar days before the first delivery.
- The deposit is refundable and is held for pantry equipment. The collection charge is the charge for collecting equipment at closure, and is a separate figure from the deposit.

Coffee & Tea Service is the only tier that carries neither a bean-to-cup espresso machine nor plumbed filtered water; Standard Snack Pantry carries plumbed filtered water without the machine; the four tiers above carry both.
